title: How firms export: product assignment, export platforms, and hybrid firms
abstract: arXiv:2606.18684v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Firms differ in manufacturing and foreign commercialization capabilities. We study how these differences organize exporting through multi-product export platforms. Products and increasingly costly platform slots form a transferable-utility assignment market. Complementarity between manufacturing and commercial capability generates positive assortative matching, while convex organizational costs determine platform scope. The equilibrium endogenously generates the four exporter types observed in firm-level trade data: direct exporters, indirect exporters, pure intermediaries, and hybrid firms. Lower contracting costs expand intermediated trade, stronger scope diseconomies fragment portfolios, and trade liberalization improves match quality. Intermediation can raise home national income by reallocating commercial capability across products.

translated_title: 企业如何出口：产品匹配、出口平台与混合型企业
translated_abstract: 企业在制造能力和外国商业化能力方面存在差异。我们研究了这些差异如何通过多产品出口平台来组织出口活动。产品与成本递增的平台位构成了一个可转移效用的匹配市场。制造能力与商业化能力之间的互补性产生了正向同质匹配，而凸性的组织成本决定了平台范围。均衡状态内生地产生了企业层面贸易数据中观察到的四种出口商类型：直接出口商、间接出口商、纯中介和混合型企业。较低的合同成本扩大了中介贸易，更强的范围不经济使产品组合碎片化，贸易自由化改善了匹配质量。中介可以通过在产品之间重新配置商业化能力来提高本国国民收入。
tldr: 本文构建了一个可转移效用的匹配模型，揭示企业制造能力与商业化能力的差异及互补性如何内生地产生直接出口商、间接出口商、纯中介和混合型企业四种出口模式，并表明中介贸易可通过重新配置商业化能力提升本国国民收入。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a transferable-utility assignment model showing how differences and complementarities in firms' manufacturing and commercialization capabilities endogenously generate four exporter types—direct exporters, indirect exporters, pure intermediaries, and hybrid firms—and demonstrates that intermediation can raise home national income by reallocating commercial capability across products.
